item.title: Version 0.6.5
item.description:
What's New

  • Spanish. Loomscreen now ships in five languages, and the language menu lists each one in its own script rather than translating the names
  • Steam Workshop tags read in your language — genre, type, maturity and feature tags, on cards, filter chips and the detail panel. Steam still matches on the English tag, so results are unchanged
  • Download sits on a browse card's right-click menu. Until now it was reachable only by opening the detail panel first

Improvements

  • Each wallpaper library gets a first-run page of its own: one colour per library, and a short account of what that library is for
  • A browse card's menu carries only browse actions now; Copy link and Copy ID moved to the detail panel, next to Download
  • Grid cards stop building an invisible badge container when both badge preferences are off — it was 10.4% of a card's construct-and-layout cost, paid on every scroll
  • Turning a display's overlay off now also stops the hourly weather fetch. Only the weather toggle used to, so a display drawing nothing kept polling
  • The System Wallpaper toolbar lets macOS space its two buttons, and no longer collides with the preferences gear

Bug Fixes

  • Global hot keys registered without reporting an error and then never fired
  • Opening Settings from the menu bar on a multi-display Mac landed on "no display selected"
  • A System Wallpaper extension left behind by an earlier install could report the installed one as incompatible and pause the whole page
  • Video textures and inspector previews no longer claim an AirPlay route

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
